sensitivity_review.interpretation: Changing only substantial-rework success from 25% to 80% moves the forecast from 55.25% to 74.5%. Moving 10 percentage points of scenario weight from local repair to interruption lowers the forecast by 8 percentage points. Joint allowed extremes span 31% to 89.45%; these are assumption bounds, not confidence intervals.
sensitivity_review.next_evidence: A contemporaneous independent inspection and dated work schedule would distinguish local repair from substantial replacement; original contract criteria are needed for exact scoring.
